contexts.text: Chedorlaomer and the kings with him = the goods and truths of the exterior man.
In the same proportion the celestial things of love are insinuated into the exterior man, and correspondence is effected.
These things properly constitute the external or exterior man.
Her name was Hagar = the life of the exterior or natural man. AC 1896. AC 1909, Described.
The Rational is born from the internal man as a father, and from the exterior or natural man as a mother.
Without the Rational as a medium, it cannot flow in with any truth into the exterior man.
There are many affections of the exterior man...
Whatever is born from the exterior man is attended with what is hereditary, thus also with evil.
From which He had command over... the Natural which was of the exterior man.
Influx into the life of the exterior man without the Rational as a medium. Signified. AC 1955.
The life of the exterior man is the affection of knowledges.
A maidservant = the affection of the Knowledges which belong to the exterior man.
